name: Pastel Goth
garments: crosses and pentagrams on soft colors
plaid in lavender/mint instead of black/red
reacts_against: traditional goth's all-black rule, replacing it with the same iconography (crosses, bats, coffins) rendered in candy colors.

findings: light — about 43% of the measured color is pale or near-white
mostly muted — about 83% of the measured color is low-saturation (greys, dusty tones)
measured.caveat: Colors measured from Aesthetics Wiki photos as photographed and displayed on screen; actual garments and materials vary, and screen colors are approximate.
